newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to supply 420,000 tonnes LNG to Spain.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to supply 420,000 tonnes LNG to Spain.

text.p: Qatar said on Saturday it had signed a deal to supply Spain with 910,000 cubic metres (420,000 tonnes) of liquefied natural gas (LNG) over some 13 months from September.
Qatar Liquefied Gas Company (Qatargas) said in a statement it signed the deal with Spanish LNG distributor Enagas.
The deal is on an FOB (freight on board) basis.
"The agreement represents the first success achieved by Qatargas in exporting LNG to European markets following its success in shipping LNG to the Japanese market," said the statement.

Qatar, which controls the world's third largest reserves of gas after Russia and Iran, aims to export 12 million tonnes a year of LNG by 2000 and up to 30 million a year early in the next century to supplement its oil income -- the lowest in the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries.

Two existing operations -- Qatargas and Ras Laffan LNG Company -- have already signed sales agreements to supply six million tonnes a year to Japan and 4.8 million tonnes a year to South Korea. A third venture - Qatar-Enron LNG Marketing Company - is on the drawing board.
